name: 98199 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98199 (Seattle) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98199 (Seattle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
